title: Ask us to move your data for you

steps.caption: Import
steps.narration: Would you rather not move your data yourself? You can ask our team to do it.

steps.caption: A person moves your data
steps.narration: At the bottom of the Import page is the hands-on option. A person moves your data, and checks it with you.

steps.caption: Which system are you on?
steps.narration: First, say which system you are leaving.

steps.caption: Something else
steps.narration: Pick it from the list. If yours is not there, choose Something else.

steps.value: Spreadsheets and paper files, about 300 clients.
steps.caption: A note
steps.narration: Add a note about what you have, like how many clients.

steps.caption: Request a hands-on migration
steps.narration: Then choose Request a hands-on migration.

steps.caption: Request received
steps.narration: The request is emailed to our team, and the page confirms it was received.

steps.caption: Keep your old account
steps.narration: Keep your old account active until everything has been checked.

steps.caption: Or import a file yourself
steps.narration: If you have a spreadsheet, you can also import it yourself, higher up on this page.

steps.caption: Where to find it
steps.narration: You reach this page from Import, on the Clients page.

youtube.title: How to ask for a hands-on data migration | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: Switching to the ConstructHUB CRM from another system? On the Import page you can ask our team to move your data for you: say which system you are leaving, add a note, and send the request. Recorded in a demo workspace.
